title: DSU: Detect Cycle in Undirected Graph
statement:
Given N nodes and E undirected edges, determine if the graph contains a cycle.

A cycle exists if you can start at a node, traverse edges without revisiting them, and return to the start. Use DSU: if adding an edge connects two nodes already in the same component, a cycle exists.

Print "Yes" if a cycle exists, otherwise "No".
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and E.
The next E lines each contain two integers u and v.
outputFormat: Print "Yes" if a cycle exists, otherwise "No".

examples.explanation: Edges form a triangle — a cycle.

n, e = map(int, input().split())
edges = [tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(e)]
